name: STK Push (Lipa Na M-Pesa Online)
description: Initiates an STK Push prompt on the customer's phone to authorize a payment.

name: STK Push Query
description: Queries the status of a previously initiated STK Push transaction.

name: C2B (Customer to Business)
description: Registers a paybill URL and simulates a customer-to-business payment.

name: B2C (Business to Customer)
description: Disburses funds from a business account to a customer's M-Pesa wallet.

name: B2B (Business to Business)
description: Moves funds between two business accounts (Buy Goods or Pay Bill).

name: Account Balance
description: Queries the balance of a paybill or till account.

name: Transaction Status
description: Queries the status of a transaction using its original transaction ID.

name: OAuth Token Generation
description: Generates an OAuth2 access token from the consumer key and consumer secret.
